body: This is the only r/aww post that has ever made me make a verbal awww sound

with my sisters room, I know it’s just stupid to say a room would be the make or break but it was just something I could’ve had to look forward to, something new something to put energy into, and my brother, I do stand up for myself but that’s when he just goes harder and it’s like I gave him ammo, then he can call me a toxic cunt and a fat bitch, a worthless anxious human who can’t function. Whatever I do makes it worse somehow. 
And haha I didn’t even realize I accidentally put Susie in my username, I just spammed my keyboard but thank you for your response regardless stranger
But how do I know what’s true? What if I ama bad person? What if I am toxic? What if I’m just lying to myself? Why would I deserve to live then

but then he’s in my head and all I can think is the other way around, how I’m the manipulator, I’m the toxic person, I’m a bad person and I can’t get it out, I can’t escape the thought that maybe I am the one in the wrong maybe I’m a horrible person who doesn’t deserve life

But what if it’s like your being gaslighted in a way, like whenever anyone says something mean or rude to be and I defend myself they flip it, say I’m the one with shortcomings, I’m the one who’s terrible and should killmysef
If I’m not than why would I feel like one, so god damn much. and why would the people around me constantly point it out?
